## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (96%)** · Confident · Careful review
The conformal set holds one class, but the second model disagrees and only 2 of 5 neighbors are Invasive [F5].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 96%, InSitu 3% | Strongly favors invasive |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.99 / percentile 1.00 | Input not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Different top class |
| Similar cases | 2 of 5 Invasive | Split; three are InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Scored far below typical; largest concept term · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Scarce; scarcity leans invasive in concept model · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 9) · ↑ invasive · Near typical; small lean toward invasive · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 3) · ↓ invasive · Below typical; mildly argues against invasive · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0: unvalidated. Normal lobules is Unreliable (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Simulated blur (severity 3) shifted the embeddings; MUSK already picks a different top class.
- The three InSitu neighbors are right and invasion is overcalled.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 5, 9**: Highest heatmap contribution; look for stromal invasion versus intact ducts.
2. **Region 6**: Strongest "atypical cells in ducts" region (weak concept); check for intact myoepithelium.
3. **Regions 1–3, 8–10**: Margin rows; confirm tumor at superior and inferior edges [F7].
